{"subject":"Claim C019505 past payer filing limit, write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C019505 (patient PT0007, service code T1019, 20 units, billed $122.00, date of service 2026-09-02) was submitted on 2026-10-27, 55 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, and the claim is predicted to deny as D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this, so I am not able to correct and resubmit it. I need a write-off decision on this claim from you. Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, since the claim cannot be filed in time to be accepted under the payer's limit.

Thank you."}
